fields.title: 📖 Zuhd is short hope
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Zuhd in the dunyā does not mean wearing coarse clothing or eating plain food. Rather, zuhd in the dunyā is: short hope.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **zuhd** is not merely outward appearance, but a heart that does not plan the **dunyā** without end and does not forget the **ākhirah**.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ, Kapitel: az-Zuhd fī Ṭalab ad-Dunyā, Band 7, S. 55.
